audience: rental, subscription and resale shops that run their orders and stock in Twice Commerce

useCases.title: Review the orders that start this week
useCases.text: List orders and narrow them by pickup location. Open one order to read its customers, line items and totals.

useCases.title: Check if an item can be booked for a period
useCases.text: Check the availability of a catalog item for a date window before you create an order.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and the orders
useCases.text: Search customers by name or email. Read the contact data and the orders of the customer.

useCases.title: Check the payments and invoices of an order
useCases.text: Read the payment transactions and the invoices of one order. The API key needs the Payments area.

useCases.title: See the stock at a location
useCases.text: List the stock items of one location with SKU, condition and status.

useCases.title: Leave a comment on an order
useCases.text: Add an internal comment to an order. The API key needs Write access to Order details.
